R1.evidence: prod-v1 healthy ~4s mount-free (issues=8040); empty+mount healthy ~2s (issues=12); live nop=0/oracle=1 on jira-assignee-count; no networks: block. R1.5 only half-holds: gateway resolved from a LOCAL tag and the agent base does an authenticated COPY --from=ghcr.io/abundant-ai/ticketvector-service with no build:+image: fallback in compose.

R2.evidence: R2.j passes (prod-v1 bakes 8040-issue corpus, serves mount-free). R2.k FAILS: agent built FROM ticketvector copies /opt/ticketvector wholesale; world_issues.seed importable and seed.py/server.py present in agent; GHCR base amd64-only (imagetools).

R3.evidence: No MCP server in the repo. linear/server.py is a read-only GraphQL HTTP gateway (BaseHTTPRequestHandler serving /graphql), not an MCP server. Agent ships jira+linear CLI only. CLI-and-MCP-parity is unachievable with current surfaces. The jira/linear tooling lives in the external ticketvector image.

R4.evidence: No docs/COVERAGE.md (find -iname '*coverage*' -> none). No machine-checkable matrix mapping capability -> endpoint/CLI/MCP/fidelity exists in this repo.

R5.evidence: Assessment-grade surface exists in substance via ticketvector (JQL grammar, issue query pagination via next_cursor, stateful transitions, comment add, realistic error envelopes with exit_code) and one write->read-style task runs, but it is undocumented and unlabelled here (no COVERAGE.md to carry the >=5 list).

R6.evidence: No pytest suite (find -name 'test_*.py' -> none). Only per-task tests/test.sh verifiers and selfcontained/smoke.sh. No parity test, no isolation pytest (R6.3), no CI workflow (.github absent).

R7.evidence: This audit emits audit/audit-report.md and audit/audit-verdict.json with per-requirement results, evidence, and an ordered file-scoped action list.

action_items.summary: No MCP server. Add an MCP server (thin client of the ticketvector /rpc API) mirroring the jira/linear CLI, COPY'd into jira-agent; or explicitly re-scope so ticketvector is the clone and this repo is its seeder.
